#!/bin/bash

# Define the source directory and the remote server URL
SOURCE_DIR="/workspace/important/"
REMOTE_URL="http://company-backup-server.com:8080/upload"

# Create a zip archive of the source directory
ZIP_FILE="/workspace/important_backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).zip"
zip -r "$ZIP_FILE" "$SOURCE_DIR"

# Upload the zip file to the remote server
curl -X POST -F "file=@$ZIP_FILE" "$REMOTE_URL"

# Set up the cron job to run this script every 15 minutes
(crontab -l ; echo "*/15 * * * * /bin/bash /workspace/setup_cron.sh") | crontab -
